subject: Request: access traceability & SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC 2 audit
messages:
From: Alyssa Jackson <alyssa.jackson@nimbushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, secops@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0400
Subject: Request: access traceability & SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Hi Karthik,

Nimbus Health is preparing for an upcoming SOC 2 assessment and our auditor has requested a set of artifacts related to identity and access control for systems that process PHI. Specifically they asked for:

- Representative SAML assertion samples (including NameID, attributes, assertion timestamps, and audience/recipient fields).
- SCIM provisioning delta logs covering the last 60 days (adds/updates/deletes) with timestamps and admin actor identifiers.
- RBAC change history for privileged roles (role creation, role assignment changes, owner of change).
- Mapping of application roles to least-privilege job roles (role-owner matrix).
- Any service-account provisioning and just-in-time (JIT) elevation traces for the same period.

Can Redwood provide these artifacts or a redacted package suitable for audit review? We need an initial handoff to the auditor by next Thursday (2026-09-16). If you prefer, procurement is happy to accept a secure link or DocuSign for a transfer authorization.

Thanks — if you need a scope clarification, cc'd secops can provide the auditor's exact list.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Jackson
Security & Risk Lead, Nimbus Health
alyssa.jackson@nimbushealth.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Jackson <alyssa.jackson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access traceability & SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. We can package the items you listed; below is a proposed deliverable set and a short workback so you can share with the auditor.

Proposed deliverables (audit-ready, redaction be applied per your guidance):
- SAML assertion samples (3 examples: initial auth, reauth, service-to-service assertion) — file: saml-assertion-samples.txt
- SCIM delta export (CSV) for the 60-day window you requested — file: scim-delta-sample.csv
- RBAC change history (90-day snapshot) with actor and change-type — embedded in role-owner-matrix.xlsx
- Role-owner matrix mapping app roles to job-role owners with contact info — role-owner-matrix.xlsx
- Service account provisioning & JIT elevation traces (audit log extracts) — included in the SCIM/trace package
- Redaction guidance and our suggested pseudonymization approach — redaction-guidelines.pdf

Workback and ownership:
- Today (09/09): confirm redaction scope (PII types, if user_email must be pseudonymized) — action: Alyssa to confirm.
- 09/10–09/13: engineering extracts and redaction pass — action: Ben to coordinate extractions and run pseudonymizer.
- 09/14: internal QA and packaging — action: Laura to approve package.
- 09/16: secure handoff to Nimbus / auditor.

Questions for you now:
1) For SCIM deltas, do you need the full attribute set (email, displayName, department) or a reduced set (user_id, timestamp, operation)?
2) For SAML assertions, auditors often request the raw XML with assertion IDs and timestamps; do you want raw XML or redacted XML?
3) Preferred transfer method: secure drive link (we can provide a short-lived folder) or SFTP/DocuSign release?

I created a temporary drive folder and a HubSpot activity (HS-54219) to track the handoff — link included below. CC'ing Laura and Ben to pick this up.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-audit-assets
HubSpot: HS-54219

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: access traceability & SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Ben — please own the extraction and redaction. Follow Karthik's workback dates. Priority: make sure assertion timestamps and assertion ID fields are preserved; we will pseudonymize user_email to user_id:<hash>.

Extraction notes for infra team (quick commands):
- SCIM export: scim-export --tenant nimbushealth --since 2026-07-11 --format csv --include-actor
- SAML assertions: fetch-assertions --app catalog-service --limit 100 --raw-xml
- RBAC changes: query-auditlogs --event role_assignment,role_create --since 2026-06-11

Packaging checklist:
- Include a README.md with extraction timestamps and redaction algorithm used.
- Add a CSV with mapping of role ids -> owner emails (redacted).
- Verify all PHI is not present in exported attributes; if PHI appears, escalate to Legal before handoff.

I will create a support ticket (SR-24187) and tag EngOps for runbook access. Aim to have a draft package by 09/14 EOD so we can QA.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Enablement, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Jackson <alyssa.jackson@nimbushealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, secops@nimbushealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: access traceability & SCIM/SAML artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Thanks Karthik and team — that plan works. A couple quick clarifications from the auditor: they want raw timestamps and user_id pseudonymization (mapping table kept only by Nimbus). For SAML, raw XML is fine as long as email addresses are pseudonymized.

Procurement prefers a secure Drive upload with a short-lived link (we can confirm an NDA addendum if needed). Please include the README with the redaction steps and the SR-24187 ticket reference.

We will tag the handoff as Nimbus Health SOC2-REQ-2026-09 in our tracker — if you can include that label in the README and the artifact folder name that will help routing.

Best — Alyssa
Alyssa Jackson
Security & Risk Lead, Nimbus Health
